headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.28
summary: Launching Minecraft no longer freezes the launcher's main thread for ~17 seconds when a patched client is installed, so the "not responding" dialog is gone and patched builds boot straight into the game.

items.text: Stop the launch ANR with patched clients by moving the client mod bridge's dex and library discovery off the main thread, and load client libraries after the game's own libraries.
